rows.grounds: accusative plural object of worship; describes entities not previously mentioned
demonstrative pronoun referring to specified locations
locative plural indicating place of worship
genitive specifying the seat or base
indeclinable indicating position over the seat

items.question: Which unprecedented entities must be worshipped in the corners above the seat?
premises: The prescribed ritual action is worship.
The specified location is in those corners above the seat.
The objects of worship are characterized as unprecedented.
items.inference: One should worship the unprecedented entities in those corners above the seat.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the unprecedented entities is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should worship the unprecedented ones in those corners above the seat.
